subtitle: UPDATE Aug 21, 44 days out from the first round and on the SIXTH DAY OF THE OFFICIAL CAMPAIGN. ⭐ A NEW NATIONAL POLL, AND IT CHANGES THE PICTURE: the VERITÁ (n=3,840, field Aug 16 to 20, BR-04006/2026) gives a STATISTICAL TIE in the first round, LULA 39.3% x FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 39.1%, where the BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 saw a 5 point gap. In the runoff it puts FLÁVIO ahead, 47.3% x 42%. ⭐ AND IT IS THE FIRST NATIONAL POLL TO MEASURE PABLO MARÇAL, who comes in at 5.2%, in THIRD, while the market pays 0.15% on him. ⚠️ Veritá carries reliability 2 on this house's scale and BTG/Nexus carries 4: the panel publishes both and declares the difference instead of choosing. IN PRICE, the distance between the top two narrowed for a FIFTH straight day and closed at 30.45pp, against 37.05pp on Aug 16, in a presidential book that has accumulated USD 130.58M. LULA has been flat at 63.50% for four days, and the narrowing of the last few days comes only from the runner-up.

candidates.name: Lula

fortes: The latest national poll, the BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 (n=2,003, field Aug 14 to 16, TSE registration BR-03317/2026), puts him at 41% in the first round, up 1 point against the same house's previous wave, which had him at 40%.
In the stimulated runoff he appears with 47% against 44%, a result IDENTICAL to the house's previous round, keeping the 3-point advantage.
The distance to the runner-up in the poll stays at 5 points, the same as the previous round, meaning the challenger's gain did not shorten the measured interval.
In the price he remains far ahead, at 64.50% against 31.45%, and his contract holds USD 8.52M inside a presidential book of USD 126.85M.

The distance to the runner-up in the price CLOSED from 37.05pp to 33.05pp, that is 4.00pp in about 26 hours.
The government rating in the BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 has 42% poor or very poor against 34% excellent or good, with 23% fair.

The Federal Police found a message in which his son and a lobbyist under investigation for INSS fraud discuss business, and the runner-up and his brother used the case the same day, according to Poder360.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 63.50% (vol USD 8.80M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC), NO CHANGE for a FOURTH straight day. ⭐ THE DISTANCE to the runner-up narrowed another 0.20pp to 30.45pp, a FIFTH straight day of convergence, adding up to 6.60pp since Aug 16. 🔑 THE SOURCE OF THE NARROWING CHANGED MIDWAY: of the 6.60pp, 3.00pp came off him, all of it between Aug 16 and 18, and he has been flat for four days. ⭐ AT THE BALLOT, the Veritá of Aug 21 (n=3,840, field Aug 16 to 20) measures him at 39.3% in the first round against 39.1% for the runner-up, a statistical tie within the 2pp margin, and at 42% in the runoff against 47.3%. The panel publishes both and declares the difference.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 33.05% (vol USD 8.72M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC)
fortes: 🔴 A 2.00pp RISE in the price in one day, from 29.45% to 31.45%, and it is the fourth straight day of gains.
The distance to the leader in the price CLOSED 4.00pp in about 26 hours, from 37.05pp to 33.05pp.
The BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 takes him from 35% to 36% in the first round, and in the runoff he repeats the previous wave's 44%.
He dominates the first-round second place contract with 85.50%, far ahead of the next name in that book.
The negative assessment of the incumbent administration stands at 42% bad or terrible in the same BTG/Nexus.

The 1-point gain sits inside the house's own 2pp margin, so it is not distinguishable from stability.
In the runoff he remains 3 points behind, 44% against 47%, exactly as in the previous round.

His campaign spent the day in a dispute with a rival from his own side: he accused Caiado of helping the leader, after Kassab said Caiado has zero chance, and Kassab replied that his campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 33.05% (vol USD 8.72M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC), up 0.20pp and a fifth straight day narrowing the distance to the leader. ⛔ NO SUPERLATIVE: 33.05% is NOT a record. candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 4.30% (vol USD 10.46M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC)
fortes: He still leads the first-round third place contract, at 52.50%, the highest probability in that book.
His contract has the LARGEST accumulated volume in the presidential book, at USD 9.95M, above the leader's own.
The BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 keeps him at 4% in the first round, the same level as recent national polls.
He opened his campaign in São Paulo on Aug 16 with a security-focused speech, according to O Globo and G1.
He publicly assessed that Pablo Marçal's possible entry into the race would benefit his rival on the right, and not him.
fracos: 🔻 DOWN in price, from 4.40% to 4.05%, giving back what he gained the previous day. The value is still close to the low: 86 of the 88 days recorded since May 22 are above it, and the low was touched on Aug 18, at 3.60%.

⚠️ His book is THIN, and that matters for reading the move: in the presidential contract he is worth a little over 4%, and in that range little money moves the price. The placement reading, in the third place contract, is where he carries real weight.
In the third place contract he also gave ground, from 53.00% to 52.50%, and the distance to the second name in that book narrowed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
🔴 IN THE POLL HE IS BEHIND CAIADO: the BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 gives 5% to Caiado and 4% to him, while the market pays 55.50% on him and 34.50% on Caiado in the third-place contract.
The high of his series is 17.90%, from Jun 9, so the Aug 20 reading, 4.45%, is a quarter of that value.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 4.30% (vol USD 10.46M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC), down 0.15pp. ⭐ In the THIRD PLACE contract he holds 55.50% (vol USD 186 thousand), against 35.00% for Ronaldo Caiado, who rose 0.50pp. 🔴 THE BALLOT CHANGED THE ORDER OF THE FIELD: the Veritá of Aug 21 puts him at 3.8%, BEHIND Pablo Marçal, who debuts in a national poll at 5.2%, and ahead of Caiado, at 3.3%. The market keeps him as the likely third and the poll puts another name in that spot: the two readings disagree on who is third, and neither converts into the other.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE for the whole field, confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC): Pablo Marçal 0.15% (vol USD 2.20M), Ronaldo Caiado 0.45% (vol USD 6.42M), Romeu Zema 0.15% (vol USD 5.80M), Fernando Haddad 0.05% (vol USD 7.28M) and Tarcísio 0.05% (vol USD 14.00M). ⚠️ All below the 0.5% floor the double reading confirms.
candidates.subtitle: Aug 20, fifth day of the campaign: the pack's move was all DOWNWARD in the price of victory, and the name that moved most was the one that just entered the race.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), presidential Poly 0.45% (vol USD 6.42M accumulated, confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC)), up 0.10pp | first round third place at 35.00% | ⚠️ below the 0.5% cutoff the double reading watches | ballot in force: Veritá of Aug 21 with 3.3% in the first round, behind Marçal and Renan Santos
caiado.fortes: ⭐ His THIRD-PLACE contract stands at 37.50%, against 31.00% at the Aug 12 close, a 6.50pp rise with four straight higher closes. In other words, the market moved him closer on PLACING while moving him away from VICTORY. In the polling he still has 4% in the Quaest of Aug 14 and the lowest rejection in the field, 35%. He opened the campaign with a mass at the Goiânia cathedral and a motorcade through Goiás and the Federal District outskirts, according to Folha de S.Paulo and G1, and said the United States does not rule Brazil, according to Times Brasil.
caiado.fracos: In the victory price he fell 0.45pp and moved to 0.60%, brushing the 0.5% cutoff. ⚠️ The 35% rejection comes with high name-recognition gaps declared by the house itself, and low rejection with high unfamiliarity is not acceptance: it means most of the electorate has not yet formed an opinion, and an unformed opinion can go either way. His contrast remains the widest on the panel, with 4% to 5.7% of declared intention against less than 1% of victory price.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), presidential Poly 0.05% (vol USD 7.28M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC), below the 0.5% cutoff | no national poll tests him for president
haddad.fortes: His cumulative volume remains larger than that of several names priced above him, which keeps the contract with trading depth despite the floor-level price. He spoke at the president's campaign-opening rally in the ABC region, according to O Globo.
haddad.fracos: ⭐ The caveat the panel had been repeating as an inference became a DATED FACT on Aug 16: he formally opened a campaign for the GOVERNORSHIP OF SÃO PAULO, according to O Globo and Times Brasil. That is, he is not a presidential candidate, and any presidential scenario that includes him is a polling hypothesis, not a candidacy under way. No national poll in the window tests him. The price fell to 0.05%, and variation in that band carries no informational value.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), presidential Poly 0.15% (vol USD 5.80M accumulated, confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC)), unchanged and below the 0.5% cutoff | first round third place at 4.90% | ballot in force: Veritá of Aug 21 with 1.3% in the first round
zema.fortes: The Quaest of Aug 14 keeps him at 2% in the first round, the same value as Aug 5, and BTG/Nexus's 3% and Meio/Ideia's 2.6% still stand. He was the first of the chasing pack to file with the electoral court, on Aug 6. He opened the campaign with a mass in Montes Claros, in northern Minas Gerais, promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Valor Econômico.
zema.fracos: 🔴 The Quaest firmness crosstab released on Aug 15 shows he has the LEAST CONVINCED electorate in the field, according to G1, which speaks to how solid his support is rather than how large. In the price he fell 0.20pp and moved to 0.15%, below the 0.5% cutoff. In the third-place contract he has 5.00%, far behind the 53.00% of the chasing pack's leader.

candidates.analise: ⭐ THE PACK HAD THE MOST RELEVANT MOVE OF THE DAY, AND IT BELONGS TO PABLO MARÇAL. He filed his presidential candidacy through the PRTB, using an opening created by the TSE (Folha, Aug 20), and on the same day the Public Prosecutor's Office asked the TSE to bar the candidacy and keep him out of debates (Folha, Aug 19). The TSE also granted an injunction barring the use of official resources in his campaign (TSE, Aug 20). 📉 The price followed: from 0.75% on Aug 19 to 0.25% in today's reading. ⚠️ METHOD CAVEAT: 0.25% sits below the 0.5% floor the capture guard watches, so it is a book reading and not a confirmed price. His series holds only 6 readings, all between 0.60% and 1.10%, and starts on Aug 17. 📌 RONALDO CAIADO gave up ground from 0.55% to 0.35%, and in the third-place contract stands at 34.50%, behind Renan Santos's 55.50%. ROMEU ZEMA repeated 0.15% and FERNANDO HADDAD repeated 0.05%.
fortes: ⭐ CAIADO ROSE IN THE POSITION CONTRACT: first-round third place went from 37.50% to 38.50%, and his distance to the leader of that book closed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
In the BTG/Nexus of Aug 17, Caiado has 5% in the first round, ABOVE Renan Santos's 4%, inverting the order the market prices.
Zema has 4% in the same BTG/Nexus, tied with Renan Santos inside the 2pp margin.
The runner-up's campaign treated Caiado as a problem on the same day: Kassab said the campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.

⭐ PABLO MARÇAL FILED HIS CANDIDACY through the PRTB, using an opening created by the TSE, according to Folha, Aug 20. On the same day the Public Prosecutor's Office asked the TSE to bar the candidacy and keep him out of debates (Folha, Aug 19), and the TSE granted an injunction barring the use of official resources in his campaign (TSE, Aug 20). 📉 On price he fell from 0.75% to 0.25% (vol USD 2.04M accumulated). ⚠️ He sits below the 0.5% cut and his series holds 6 readings, all between 0.60% and 1.10%, starting Aug 17. He remains INELIGIBLE until 2032 and the registration awaits a TSE decision. The Datafolha of Aug 21 is the first to measure him.
fracos: 🔻 Caiado fell again in the victory contract, from 0.55% to 0.35%, and is now BELOW the 0.5% cut watched by the double reading. In the third-place contract he stands at 34.50%, behind Renan Santos's 55.50%.
Zema remains at 0.25%, below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to separate price from noise.
Both win contracts in the pack sit at a level where a one-hundredth change already shifts the relative percentage, and the panel treats that as shape, not signal.
Kassab, who is the running mate on Caiado's ticket, publicly said he has zero chance in the election, and then said he had been misinterpreted, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão.
Zema opened the week promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, and that still has no translation into price, with 4.95% in the third place contract.

What the panel records is the opposite ordering, not a difference figure. Beyond that, the legal squeeze of Aug 19 and 20 remains unresolved.

cruzamento: ⭐ THE BALLOT SPOKE AGAIN AFTER FOUR DAYS, AND IT DISAGREES WITH THE PRICE ON TWO POINTS AT ONCE. On the confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC), LULA repeated 63.50% (vol USD 8.80M), no change for a FOURTH straight day, and FLÁVIO BOLSONARO rose 0.20pp to 33.05% (vol USD 8.72M). The distance between them went to 30.45pp, a FIFTH straight day of convergence: it was 37.05pp on Aug 16, 33.05pp on the 17th, 31.45pp on the 18th, 30.95pp on the 19th and 30.65pp on the 20th, that is 6.60pp in five days. 🔑 THE SOURCE OF THE NARROWING CHANGED MIDWAY: of the 6.60pp, 3.00pp came off the leader, all of it between Aug 16 and 18, and 3.60pp came from the runner-up, who rose on every day. ⛔ NO SUPERLATIVE: 33.05% is NOT a record. In the series of 174 readings since May 23, only 2 print 33.05% or above, and both are 33.20%, from Jun 2 and Aug 18. ⭐ THE STORY OF THE DAY IS THE POLL. The VERITÁ (n=3,840, field Aug 16 to 20, registration BR-04006/2026, 2pp margin) gives a STATISTICAL TIE in the first round, 39.3% x 39.1%, and puts FLÁVIO ahead in the runoff, 47.3% x 42%. Four days earlier, the BTG/Nexus measured 41% x 36% and a runoff of 47% x 44% the other way. ⚠️ THE TWO INSTITUTES ARE NOT MEASURING THE SAME FIELD: this round includes Pablo Marçal and the previous one did not, and Veritá carries reliability 2 on the panel's scale against 4 for BTG/Nexus. The panel publishes both readings and declares the difference, instead of choosing the one that confirms the previous reading. ⭐ PABLO MARÇAL ENTERS THE CROSS-REFERENCE FOR THE FIRST TIME, and this is where the two instruments disagree most: the ballot puts him THIRD at 5.2%, ahead of Renan Santos (3.8%) and Ronaldo Caiado (3.3%), while the price puts him SEVENTH at 0.15%, below the 0.5% floor the double reading confirms. ⛔ The two quantities do not subtract: voting intention and probability of winning measure different things. The panel records the opposite ordering and does not convert one into the other. 📌 IN THE THIRD PLACE CONTRACT the market pays 55.50% on Renan Santos against 35.00% on Ronaldo Caiado, who rose 0.50pp. ⚠️ There is no new confirmed reading on Aug 21 for the second place contract, which stands at 87.50% since Aug 20. In the SENATE the PL is at 79.00% (vol USD 259 thousand) and the contract on the impeachment of a supreme court justice did not move, at 3.35% (vol USD 84 thousand). ⏭️ THE NATIONAL DATAFOLHA was announced for Aug 21 and had not been released as of this reading.
